messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: Alert: SLO breach detected for text-generation streaming endpoints in us-west-2. p95 and p99 increased suddenly starting ~12:34 UTC. Paging oncall. Automated mitigation candidates suggested.
Tom (oncall): on it. grabbing dashboards + logs. any customer-impact list?
Priya (cs): hearing from 3 customers about stalls in streaming completions (Acme, Nova Labs, Finch). They report timeouts or very long stalls. Priya -> will open cases and add to incident ticket.
Tom (oncall): p95 jumped from ~220ms to 3.2s; p99 from ~900ms to ~27s. Streaming stalls visible as long gaps between data frames. Rolling averages show spike correlated with router errors.
Jens (infra): seeing a lot of 502/504s at the router tier, and some backends get 100% of traffic from certain load-balancer buckets. Looks like misrouting to a small subset of router pods (hot partition).
Aisha (sre): can you paste the router policy diff? I want to see recent changes.
Jens (infra): recent deploy to route-policy service at 12:20 UTC. Diff has a new fallback rule for unavailable zone that accidentally prefers us-east-1 for streaming routes when zone metrics are stale. snippet: `- fallback: nearest
+ fallback: prefer:us-east-1`
Tom (oncall): that would explain cross-region hops and tail latency. streaming is sensitive to cross-region RTT and also to KV cache locality.
Priya (cs): severity escalated by customers; two are considering failover. Want ETA for mitigation.
Tom (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert route-policy to previous stable (rollback), 2) drain misrouted router pods, 3) pin streaming routes to local pools for 30m. Doing rollback now.
Jens (infra): rolling back route-policy to v2.2 (pre-change). command: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/route-policy --to-revision=2`
OpsBot: Deploy bot: rollback job started for deploy/route-policy at 12:42:11 UTC.
Tom (oncall): rolling, watching metrics. Also scaling router pool by +30% to reduce chance of hot partition. command: `scale router pool --name=us-west-stream --replicas=13`
Aisha (sre): I see p95 down to ~900ms within 2 minutes of rollback, p99 still elevated ~6-8s, but streaming stalls frequency reduced. Good sign.
Jens (infra): forcing lb rebalance on the router autoscaler to redistribute buckets. running: `curl -XPOST http://lb-control/rebalance?env=us-west-2`
Tom (oncall): after rebalance, p99 trending toward 2.1s, p95 ~320ms. But we still have a small tail at ~5-8s. Investigating whether a hot cache shard still exists (KV cache pinned to the misrouted pods).
Aisha (sre): identified hot partition id=42 pinned to pod router-7. It's still serving leftover sticky sessions. Draining router-7 now. command: `kubectl drain router-7 --ignore-daemonsets --force`
PagerDuty Bot: Tom acknowledged the incident at 12:43:07 UTC. Handoff scheduled to night oncall in 2 hours if unresolved.
Jens (infra): drained router-7; traffic redistributed. p99 returned to ~1.2s after drain, p95 ~280ms. Streaming stalls appear cleared in telemetry; no new customer complaints in the last 6 minutes.
Priya (cs): updating customers: let them know rollback performed, routing bug likely cause, monitoring in place. Will offer postmortem and credit if SLA hit.
Tom (oncall): summary for initial incident: root cause - route-policy change introduced a prefer-us-east fallback that misrouted streaming traffic causing cross-region latency + hot partitions. Impact - elevated p95/p99 and streaming stalls for some customers in us-west-2. Mitigation - rollback route-policy, rebalance LB, drain hot pod, scale router pool.
Aisha (sre): next actions: 1) postmortem with timeline and tests to prevent fallback regressions, 2) create an integration test for route-policy that simulates stale zone metrics, 3) add automated canary that watches streaming tail-latency per zone. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign owners.
Jens (infra): also adding a quick guardrail: prevent route-policy from preferring cross-region fallbacks for streaming endpoints unless explicitly enabled. Raising PR now.
Tom (oncall): will stay on until metrics fully stable and POps confirms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Incident closed for active paging at 13:07:00 UTC by Tom (oncall) — monitoring for 30m.
Priya (cs): I'll keep customer comms open for the next hour.
Aisha (sre): capturing logs and snapshots for postmortem. Saving export: `s3://redwood-incident-exports/1719001234/`
Tom (oncall): handing off to night oncall (Jorge) at 13:30 UTC — see incident ticket #INC-1719001234.
